d:
He wanted everyone to know that while they’ve witnessed the hustle on stage, the real struggle lies in getting there. During the auditions, he crossed paths with someone who didn’t make it to this moment. That encounter stayed with him, inspiring a track that tells the story of their conversation, a raw reflection on ambition, setbacks, and the drive to keep pushing forward.
